interactions.summary: A student rejects heaven as either nonexistent or inherently exclusionary and stagnant; Jiang pushes back that this is the wrong mode of answer for the class because it stays in logic and critique rather than imaginative participation.
Jiang explicitly says that to embrace Dante the class must use intuition and imagination, then affirms another student's vision of paradise as perfect joy beyond imagination.
interactions.speaker_attribution: Jiang method statement with student answer

interactions.summary: Another student offers a recognizably Christian or Catholic definition of heaven as eternal life in God's presence, worship, and reward.

claims.claim: Jiang rejects a purely logical or skeptical response to heaven because it misses the imaginative mode he wants the Dante class to inhabit.
To truly embrace Dante, Jiang says readers must rely on intuition and imagination rather than treat the text as an exercise in abstract reasoning.
claims.temporal_scope: Method claim on 2026-06-15 for reading Dante.

claims.claim: Jiang explicitly says imagination is what will lead the class to truth.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang does not neutrally welcome the skeptical answer; he says in effect that the class has to change its instrument of knowing if it wants Dante.
signature_moments.source_phrase: that's not the answer I want
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It makes the workshop's hermeneutic explicit: modern critique alone is not enough to enter Dante's universe.

signature_moments.moment: Imagination, not logic, is announced as the path to truth.
signature_moments.source_phrase: the imagination is what will lead you to the truth
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This is one of the session's core methodological axioms and will govern how later cosmology, poetry, and symbol are discussed.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: A mode of apprehending Dante that Jiang contrasts with analytic logic and formal exam-style reasoning.
The faculty Jiang says leads to truth and is necessary for entering Dante's vision of heaven.

chronology_notes.note: Early in the 2026-06-15 Dante workshop, Jiang fixes the course's reading posture: imagination and intuition precede analytical skepticism.
